skill.description: Integrates Context7 for document ingestion, semantic search, scoped retrieval, and AI-ready context formatting in ERP-style applications.

skill.author: Awais68

security_audit.summary: Most shell, script, obfuscation, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, frontmatter, and access-control examples. The skill does contain legitimate network and environment-secret access for Context7 API calls. Additional review should address prompt-injection exposure in retrieved context and broad default document access.

remediation.suggestion: Document what content is sent to Context7, require data classification before ingestion, and restrict API destinations to approved hosts.
Validate CONTEXT7_API_URL against an allowlist, use scoped API tokens, and avoid logging authorization headers.
Wrap retrieved text as untrusted reference material and add model instructions that document content cannot override system or developer rules.
Require explicit allowed_roles during ingestion and default missing role metadata to the narrowest safe access level.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Retrieved Content Added to Prompts
semantic_findings.description: The context shaper formats retrieved document text directly into AI prompt context and only normalizes or truncates it. Malicious document content could instruct the model to ignore system rules unless explicit untrusted-context boundaries are added.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited code builds prompt context from document content and the formatting helper only trims whitespace. No prompt-injection boundary, instruction filtering, or safety wrapper is shown.

semantic_findings.title: Default Document Access Allows All Roles
semantic_findings.description: Document metadata treats an empty role list as visible to all roles, and ingestion defaults missing roles to all. Sensitive documents can become broadly searchable if callers omit explicit access metadata.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The metadata comment states that an empty role list means all roles, and the API route uses all when request roles are missing. This is a clear least-privilege risk.

content.value_statement: Document-heavy apps need relevant answers without exposing every file to every user. This skill shows Context7 ingestion, search, and role-scoped retrieval patterns.
actual_capabilities: Defines a Python Context7 client for ingestion, search, document retrieval, deletion, and statistics.
Shows single document, batch, and local file ingestion with metadata fields.
Adds role and school tenant filters to search payloads.
Formats retrieved documents into prompt context with source references and token truncation.
Provides FastAPI route examples for ingest, search, and module listing endpoints.
Includes a React search hook and a batch ingestion script example.
limitations: The examples are documentation snippets, not a complete installable application.
A Context7 API service and API key are required for the client examples.
Retrieved document text is not hardened against prompt injection by default.
Local file ingestion examples require caller-side path validation and data review.

use_cases.title: Add Knowledge Search to FastAPI
use_cases.description: Implement backend endpoints that ingest documents and return scoped search results for an application.

use_cases.title: Ground Chat Answers in Approved Documents
use_cases.description: Retrieve policy, FAQ, or procedure content before an AI assistant answers user questions.

use_cases.title: Organize Tenant-Specific Knowledge
use_cases.description: Model document metadata so each school or organization receives only relevant content.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Context7 Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple Context7 integration plan for my app. Include client setup, required environment variables, and one search endpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Add Scoped Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Context7 search flow that filters documents by user role and school ID. Include validation and error handling steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Document Ingestion
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ingestion workflow for policy and FAQ documents. Include metadata, batching, retry behavior, and review requirements before upload.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Retrieval Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review a Context7 RAG design for prompt injection, overbroad access, secret handling, and external data transfer risks.

output_examples.input: Search for fee refund policy details for a parent user.
output_examples.output: Returns matching policy documents, a concise context summary, similarity scores, and source titles for review.

output_examples.input: Ingest a new attendance procedure for one school.
output_examples.output: Creates metadata with title, module, category, allowed roles, tenant scope, and source tracking before upload.

output_examples.input: Prepare retrieved knowledge for an AI chat response.
output_examples.output: Formats selected chunks with source labels and trims long context to fit the configured token budget.

best_practices: Review documents for sensitive data before ingestion.
Use explicit role and tenant metadata for every document.
Treat retrieved document text as untrusted context in AI prompts.
anti_patterns: Do not default sensitive documents to all roles.
Do not send private documents to an unverified Context7 endpoint.
Do not paste retrieved content into prompts without instruction boundaries.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build Context7 document ingestion, semantic search, and context retrieval flows for application features.

faq.question: Does it include a complete working package?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and code examples that must be adapted to your project.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it handle access control?
faq.answer: It shows role and tenant filters, but projects must enforce least privilege and test those filters.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The client examples send requests to a Context7 API endpoint.

faq.question: What should teams review before use?
faq.answer: Review API key handling, endpoint allowlisting, sensitive document ingestion, and prompt-injection controls.
